lines.speaker: Aloo
lines.text: Yar Tamatar, teri chai mein itna namak hai ke samandar bhi sharminda ho jaye.
lines.action: chai ka cup utha kar hawa mein hilata hai

lines.speaker: Tamatar
lines.text: Oye Aloo, tu to apni chai mein cheeni daal ke sharbat bana leta hai!
lines.action: apni chai ki taraf ishara karta hai

lines.speaker: Aloo
lines.text: Cheeni? Main to keh raha hoon tu namak factory mein chai peeta hai.
lines.action: ankhen bada kar ke dikhata hai

lines.speaker: Tamatar
lines.text: Achha, tu bata de chai ka maza namak se aata hai ya cheeni se?

lines.speaker: Aloo
lines.text: Maza to doodh se aata hai, lekin tu to doodh bhi namak se dho leta hai!
lines.action: hasta hai aur sar hilata hai

lines.speaker: Tamatar
lines.text: Chal be, teri chai mein itni cheeni hai ke diabetes ka patient bhi dar jaye.
lines.action: chai ka cup aage badhata hai

lines.speaker: Aloo
lines.text: Theek hai, aaj se main bhi namak daal kar peeta hoon—tere naam par!
lines.action: chai ka cup utha kar toast karta hai

lines.speaker: Tamatar
lines.text: Aur main cheeni daal kar peeta hoon—tere naam par! Phir dekhte hain kaun zyada funny hai.
lines.action: apna cup utha kar wapis toast karta hai
